customManagers.description: The licence tool image: release in the comment above, digest in the line.
The actionlint release and checksum in the CI workflow.
matchStrings:
ACTIONLINT_VERSION: "(?<currentValue>v[^"]+)"
  # SHA-256 of actionlint_\S+_linux_amd64\.tar\.gz, from the release's checksum file\.
  ACTIONLINT_SHA256: "(?<currentDigest>[0-9a-f]{64})"
customManagers.autoReplaceStringTemplate:
ACTIONLINT_VERSION: "{{{newValue}}}"
  # SHA-256 of actionlint_{{{replace '^v' '' newValue}}}_linux_amd64.tar.gz, from the release's checksum file.
  ACTIONLINT_SHA256: "{{{newDigest}}}"
